$comment: Components in Electron's packages that Electron's LICENSES.chromium.html does not list (found on 2026-10-17 by matching every binary in the package to a notice). The license texts were taken unchanged from the official repositories; the d3dcompiler row's text is the protections of the Windows SDK license that must be passed on to end users (written for Momotombo, awaiting legal review: tools/windows-terms.json). 'files': path patterns from the package root; tools/codec-audit.mjs checks that these files have a notice. The version, license and source fields are shown as is on the app's Licenses screen, so they are in Spanish.
